svg.title: Quick Insert
svg.desc: The Quick insert block callout window, opened from Callout Studio's ribbon button, lists rendered previews of every callout: Abstract, Bug, Danger, Example, Failure, Idea, Info, Meeting and more, each with edit and wrap actions.
